decision: Selected the WGS84 point that the national classified-installations register (Géorisques installations_classees API) publishes for establishment AIOT 0007409817, EQUINIX FRANCE SAS, 110 BIS AVENUE DU GENERAL LECLERC, 93500 Pantin: longitude 2.421797, latitude 48.900257, copied without transformation, as the campus locator.
operator_published_address: 110 Bis avenue du General Leclerc, 93500 Pantin (Equinix PA4 page, Internet Archive copy of 3 October 2026); the PA8x page gives the same street address, Building 19
identity_bridge: The register names EQUINIX FRANCE SAS at '110 BIS AVENUE DU GENERAL LECLERC, 93500 Pantin', NAF 63, regime Autorisation, IED, 'En exploitation avec titre'.

The DRIEAT inspection report of the 15 October 2025 visit (published on Géorisques for AIOT 0007409817) says the site, on a former postal sorting centre with access in Pantin and extending into Bobigny, was authorised on 24 January 2011 as a data centre named 'PA4', operated by Equinix France SAS since a change-of-operator declaration of 1 August 2013 (operated since 2012), and that a new building 'PA8' (ground plus two storeys with basement) was built in 2018; it counts 22 generators dedicated to building PA4 and 12 to building PA8.
Equinix's PA4 page (Internet Archive copy of 3 October 2026) gives the address 110 Bis avenue du General Leclerc, 93500 Pantin; its PA8x page gives the same street address, Building 19.

transform.note: No transform is applied to the published longitude and latitude. Check only: pyproj 3.7.1 EPSG:2154 -> EPSG:4326 of the register's Lambert-93 coordinates (657611, 6866850) gives a point 0.024 m from the published one.

consistency_checks.cadastral_parcel: The IGN API Carto cadastre service queried with the register point (local local_data/country-research-equinix-emea-2-p13/ign-apicarto-parcel-at-icpe-point-pa4.json, sha256 ef4fd92a7c99...) returns the single parcel 930550000S0087 (section 0S, no. 0087, contenance 11,237 m2). With shapely 2.1.1 in Lambert-93 the point lies inside it, 36.1 m from its boundary and 22.3 m from its centroid (2.4215733, 48.9003933); the parcel's geodesic area is 10,695 m2 and its extent about 136 m by 157 m.
